item.title: Molecular physics-informed neural network (mPINN) for solving the molecular dynamics equation of motion with energy conservation
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Temoor Muther, Vuong Van Pham and Amirmasoud Kalantari Dahaghi
Machine learning (ML) is increasingly utilized in molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to investigate complex system properties across disciplines ranging from chemical and physical sciences to engineering. However, these methods often require large datasets for model training and may not fully adhere to physical principles, limiting their scientific explainability. Furthermore, the model training remains highly challenging under sparse data. To overcome these limitations, this paper introduces the Molecular Physics-Informed Neural Network (mPINN) framework, designed to solve Newton’s equations of motion for multi-body atomistic interactions without relying on prior observational time-series data. arXiv:2608.02209v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric nematic liquids exhibit complex ferroelectric domains shaped by competing elastic and electrostatic interactions. Using fluorescence and polarizing optical microscopy, we investigate domain formation and evolution under different anchoring conditions. Upon cooling, domain walls transform from Ising- to Néel-type configurations, lowering the electrostatic potential, and reversibly recover upon heating.
